findings.reason: The accepted RS-11 assigns the FW ordinary reverse bound to C.L1 and promises an import from C.L2, while the live graph has C.L1 -> C.L2. Keep SU at C.L1; assign this FW route to C.L2 or a successor, and retain final equality assembly at I.L1. Correct the owner and link reasons. BCS 2405.00270v2 p.10 derives the cyclotomic theorem from early product divisibility, auxiliary fields, control and four Kato bounds; its p.11 anticyclotomic proof is separate. Keep L5w -> L5a -> {L5b, HE.8b}; remove the completed HE.8b prerequisite of L5b, retaining its direct Kato input. A comparison requiring both endpoints belongs later. Both cuts remove every C.L4 -> I.L3 path in the complete assembled graph. Preserve rational/integral and rank-one-image hypotheses. Coordinate with area finding /31.

The corrected RS-11 locator leaves C.L5a owning the comparison without a supplier, while BSD.6a expressly owns BSTW's zeta element, both reciprocity laws and main-conjecture comparison. BCS 2405.00270v2 Theorem 4.1.3 cites BSTW section 9.3.2; Corollary 4.1.4 takes products. I independently read BSTW 2409.01350v2 Theorem 1.14 and Proposition 9.18 with sequences (9.11)-(9.13). Retain p not dividing 2N, split-field and discriminant conditions, van_L for integrality and nv for cyclotomic comparison; distinguish completed unramified coefficients and p-inverted variants. Ordinary import does not discharge signed construction. The proposed ID is absent from live stages and reserved IDs. Its six-input/two-output prefix is jointly acyclic with the other repairs in the complete assembled graph; the actual analytic supplier contract and full arithmetic construction remain required at implementation.
